title: AMD and OpenAI announce strategic partnership to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs
summary: AMD and OpenAI have announced a multi-year partnership to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs, beginning with 1 gigawatt in 2026, to power OpenAI’s next-generation AI infrastructure and accelerate global AI innovation.
body: AMD and OpenAI have announced a multi-year partnership to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs, beginning with 1 gigawatt in 2026, to power OpenAI’s next-generation AI infrastructure and accelerate global AI innovation.
summaryZh: AMD与OpenAI正式宣布建立多年期战略合作伙伴关系，计划部署总计6吉瓦的AMD Instinct系列GPU算力。该合作将从2026年率先部署1吉瓦开始，全面支撑OpenAI下一代人工智能基础设施的建设，并加速全球AI技术的创新步伐。

aiReview.reasonZh: AMD与OpenAI达成署多吉瓦规模GPU部署的战略合作，对算力格局和行业生态产生重大影响。

glossary.explanationZh: 吉瓦，用于衡量大规模AI数据中心所需庞大电力和算力规模的单位
AMD专为人工智能和高性能计算设计的GPU硬件系列
支撑大规模模型训练与推理的底层计算和网络基础设施
